title: Full subagent intelligence: real LLM subagents producing real output

implementation_summary.scene_designer_md: Updated to produce scene.yaml matching actual scene.py Pydantic schema (stacks.{name}.layers, scene_xyz, plate_size, perspective_px, bg_color). Includes worked example matching canonical forest.yaml format.
implementation_summary.camera_pather_md: Updated to describe actual CameraSpec schema (drone: {path: {kind: bezier, controls, duration_s}, poi_lookahead_s, spring_halflife_s, noise, bank_from_velocity} and keyframed mode). Translation table updated. Return format updated to match new schema.
implementation_summary.lead_py_layer_parsing: Fixed _run_asset_generators to handle canonical stacks.{name}.layers format. Now supports both new canonical dict format and legacy plain-list format.
implementation_summary.lead_py_mask_parsing: Fixed _run_mask_authors to use path_svg field (canonical). Falls back to legacy silhouette_svg and svg fields.
implementation_summary.test_subagent_output_schemas: 39 tests covering: scene.yaml schema compliance (7), SVG asset structure (6), SVG mask silhouette+hole (8), lead layer discovery (4), lead mask discovery (3), QA integer counter (3), prompt constraints (7).
